title: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games
summary: We prove the 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness. For every fixed rational $`\delta\in(0,1)`$, it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable 2-to-1 games from games of value at most δ , with a fixed alphabet and an explicitly listed unweighted multiset of constraints.

review.reason: Proves NP-hardness for the 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness.
